claim: sync_version.py canonical pattern: single source of truth src/orama_system/_version.py __version__. Bump workflow: edit _version.py only, then python3 scripts/sync_version.py (propagates to 25+ surfaces), then pytest tests/test_version_docs.py, then git commit. Dry-run: --dry-run; CI gate: --check (exits 1 if stale). Surfaces include SKILL.md frontmatter, CLAUDE.md, README badge, agent_registry.json, routing_rules.json, portal_server.py, install.ps1, PERPLEXITY_BRIDGE.md, SYNC_ANALYSIS.md, afrp/README.md, self-discovery/SKILL.md, bin/agents/*/agent.md, bin/mcp_servers/*.py, bin/shared/*.py. Historical docs (CHANGELOG, LESSONS, plans) intentionally excluded.
